title: CSE Signal Definition Schema
description: JSON Schema for CSE canonical signal definitions (signals/**/signal.json) as defined by the CSE Signal Definition Format Specification v1.0.

canonical_name.description: Human-readable canonical name for the signal.

description.description: Normative description of what the signal represents (descriptive, not prescriptive).

domain.description: High-level domain or framework context (e.g., GEN, CMMC, ISO27001, GDPR).

category.description: Functional signal category (e.g., ACCESS, SECRETS, LOGGING, CONFIG).

applicability.description: Scope and context where the signal is relevant (systems, artifacts, environments).

metadata.description: Optional, informative metadata. MUST NOT redefine the signal meaning.

suggested_severity.description: Optional, non-normative severity suggestion for implementations.

related_controls.description: Optional list of related control identifiers (framework-specific strings).

risk_domains.description: Optional list of risk domain tags for categorization.

detection_notes.description: Optional, informative notes about common detection approaches.

references.description: Optional list of external references (URLs or citations) for context.

cseId.description: CSE identifier in the format CSE-<DOMAIN>-<CATEGORY>-<NAME>-<SERIAL>.
